tasks.title: Prevent RolePermissions from saving an empty permission set on catalog failure
acceptanceCriteria: The role permission form is not rendered as editable until both the role and the permission catalog load successfully.
If the catalog query fails, Save is disabled or absent and no SetRolePermissions command can be sent.
The page shows a clear error message and does not clear or replace the existing role permissions.
RoleCreate applies the same guard when the catalog fails.
A component test simulates catalog failure and asserts that no command is dispatched.

tasks.title: Fix demo sample-data seeding so it satisfies authorization revalidation
acceptanceCriteria: Demo seeding executes through a trusted system path that bypasses authorization revalidation, or creates a real persisted session and sets its session id.
The seeder tracks per-record failures and reports success only when the expected CRM and Sales records exist.
An integration test enables demo seeding and asserts that the expected records are created.
Behavior is unchanged when demo seeding flags are disabled.

tasks.title: Eliminate stale DbContext state across Blazor circuit writes
acceptanceCriteria: CRM, Sales and Home write operations use a per-operation scope or equivalent so failed changes are not retained in circuit-scoped DbContexts.
TransactionBehavior clears or detaches tracked changes on rollback or exception.
A regression test sends a command that mutates then fails, followed by a successful command in the same scope, and asserts the failed change is not persisted.
Existing AdministrationDispatcher tests continue to pass.
tasks.lastError: Review verdict: Approved With Changes (not Approved). No Critical/High. Required: (1) DiscardPendingChanges contract mismatch - IUnitOfWork XML says it discards the transaction but implementations only clear tracked changes and null the transaction; either document precisely or make it rollback+dispose safely. (2) Regression coverage gap - CrmCircuitWriteIsolationTests passes even if module DiscardPendingChanges is a no-op because CircuitDispatcher uses a new scope per command; add a CompositeUnitOfWork discard propagation test, a ChangeTracker.Clear assertion, and a failure-then-success scenario on a reused UoW/scope. Low: document IDatabaseTransaction.DisposeAsync rollback semantics, use CreateAsyncScope in CircuitDispatcher, inject CircuitDispatcher into AdministrationDispatcher.

tasks.title: Map Identity HTTP concurrency conflicts to the platform 409 contract
acceptanceCriteria: Identity endpoints return HTTP 409 with the same ProblemDetails shape used by CRM and Sales when a ConcurrencyConflictException is raised.
An integration test forces an Identity concurrency conflict at the HTTP layer and asserts the 409 contract.
CRM and Sales behavior is unchanged.

tasks.title: Hide tenant-scoped navigation when the user has no active tenant
acceptanceCriteria: CRM, Sales and tenant-administration navigation items are hidden or replaced by a workspace-selection prompt when WebCurrentUser.TenantId is null.
Platform-only pages remain accessible to users without a tenant.
Tests cover a platform-only user, a tenant user and a user whose platform role carries tenant-scoped permissions.

tasks.title: Make write-only custom roles usable or fail gracefully
acceptanceCriteria: Pages that require a write permission do not attempt to load data guarded by a separate read permission without handling the denial.
After a successful create or update, the user is redirected to a page they can actually open, or the result is shown in place.
The solution either enforces write-implies-read for tenant resources or provides explicit graceful-degradation behavior.
Tests cover create-only and update-only roles across CRM, Sales and Identity.

tasks.title: Unify API error responses with ProblemDetails
acceptanceCriteria: Requests under /identity, /crm and /sales return application/problem+json for 401, 403, 404, 409 and unhandled 500 responses.
The ProblemDetails title is human-readable and the stable machine code is in extensions.code or type.
Unknown API routes and unauthenticated API requests no longer return HTML or empty bodies.
Contract tests cover each status code on each module.

tasks.title: Harden outbox recovery with periodic stale requeue and poison-message isolation
acceptanceCriteria: Stale processing rows are requeued periodically, not only during the first loop pass.
Malformed payloads are marked failed or dead-lettered and do not stall other rows or stores.
Tests cover a stale row requeued after the first pass and a malformed payload isolated from healthy rows.

tasks.title: Replace permission string literals with module constants
acceptanceCriteria: No [RequirePermission("...")] string literal remains in CRM or Identity Application; all use module permission constants.
Web PermissionPolicies reference module constants instead of duplicating permission strings.
An architecture test rejects literal permission codes in RequirePermission attributes.
Build and tests pass.

tasks.title: Remove duplicated domain limits and password policy from Web forms
acceptanceCriteria: Web form validation attributes reference module domain constants or shared validators instead of re-declaring lengths, formats and numeric limits.
The password policy is defined once and used by Identity application validators and Web forms.
Tests prove that Web and domain limits stay aligned for customer, address, lead, opportunity and user forms.

tasks.title: Centralize tenant isolation query filters and tenant scopes
acceptanceCriteria: The fail-closed tenant and soft-delete query filter is implemented once in shared persistence and reused by CRM and Sales.
Tenant scope and tenant resolver duplication is removed or reduced to module-specific typed wrappers.
Parity tests prove CRM and Sales keep identical tenant-isolation behavior.

tasks.title: Centralize the membership role assignment rule
acceptanceCriteria: The rule that a membership role must be tenant-owned, non-system and belong to the same tenant lives in one domain method or policy.
AssignRoleToMembership and ChangeMembershipRole use that single implementation and return the same error codes.
Unit tests cover both handlers and the shared rule.

tasks.title: Add tenant-scoped Identity lookups and remove the cross-tenant existence oracle
acceptanceCriteria: Identity tenant-owned lookups are scoped by the current tenant or return NotFound for cross-tenant resources.
No endpoint distinguishes a missing resource from a resource that exists in another tenant.
Security tests cover cross-tenant membership, role and service-account enumeration.
An architecture test fails tenant-owned repository access that is not tenant-scoped.

tasks.title: Deduplicate JWT validation parameters and claim names
acceptanceCriteria: One shared factory or configuration builds JWT validation parameters for both token issuance/validation and endpoint authentication.
Claim names are defined once and consumed by the issuer, validator and Web authentication layer.
Tests assert issuer, validator and Web agree on issuer, audience, lifetime, clock skew and claim names.

tasks.title: Add CancellationToken support to Blazor page operations
acceptanceCriteria: Blazor pages create a cancellation scope per operation and cancel it on dispose or navigation.
All ISender and Dispatcher calls receive the cancellation token.
Tests prove that navigation away cancels in-flight work.

tasks.title: Reload route-parameter pages when the ID changes
acceptanceCriteria: Detail and edit pages with route IDs load data in OnParametersSetAsync or equivalent and reload when the ID changes.
Navigating from record A to record B on the same route renders record B.
bUnit tests cover A-to-B navigation for CRM, Sales and Identity detail/edit pages.

tasks.title: Add ErrorBoundary and recoverable error UI to the Blazor app
acceptanceCriteria: An ErrorBoundary wraps routed content and shows a recoverable error UI with a correlation id.
Unexpected exceptions do not permanently break navigation; the user can retry or return to a safe page.
A component test throws inside a page and asserts the recovery UI is rendered.

tasks.title: Fix outbox batching and populate tenant and correlation metadata
acceptanceCriteria: Pending outbox rows are filtered and limited in SQL, not loaded fully into memory.
Claims use a set-based update or equivalent and avoid one update per row.
TenantId and CorrelationId are populated when available.
Tests cover batch-size limits and metadata population.

tasks.title: Make outbox-disabled and integration-publishing modes fail safe
acceptanceCriteria: Disabling the outbox does not silently disable domain event dispatch; the system either falls back to direct dispatch or fails fast at startup.
Integration publishing never marks rows processed when only NoOpEventBus is registered.
Integration rows are claimed atomically before publishing.
Tests cover disabled mode, no-op bus and concurrent publishers.

tasks.title: Bound and expire in-memory rate-limit stores
acceptanceCriteria: Expired rate-limit windows are removed and memory does not grow without bound.
Attacker-controlled partition keys cannot create permanent entries.
Tests cover eviction and expiry.
The single-instance limitation is documented in code.

tasks.title: Fix Identity user list ordering and case-insensitive name search
acceptanceCriteria: Users are ordered deterministically by name and email, or by a documented order other than AccessFailedCount.
Name search is case-insensitive on PostgreSQL and SQLite.
Tests cover mixed-case name search and default ordering.

tasks.title: Remove membership N+1 queries and add server-side paging and search
acceptanceCriteria: Membership listing uses a join/projection or batched user lookup instead of one user query per membership.
Paging and search are performed server-side.
A test asserts a bounded number of user queries for N memberships.

tasks.title: Add a workspace home summary query and remove bounded scans from Home
acceptanceCriteria: Home uses a dedicated summary query or read model for counts, the best qualified lead and conversion state.
Correctness does not depend on scanning only the first 100 leads or opportunities.
URLs come from a shared route helper or NavigationCatalog instead of hardcoded strings.
Tests cover workspaces with more than 100 leads and opportunities.

tasks.title: Send password-reset notifications only after the transaction commits
acceptanceCriteria: The reset notification is queued only after a successful commit.
If the commit fails, no reset email is sent.
A test simulates commit failure and asserts no notification is dispatched.

tasks.title: Remove verified dead code and unused abstractions
acceptanceCriteria: IAuditableEntity, ISoftDeletable, PermissionCatalog.ForScope, UserMappings.ToSummary, unused OutboxMessage.Mark* methods and ICrmReferenceValidator are removed or wired to a real consumer.
Build and tests pass.
No public API outside the listed types is broken.

tasks.title: Remove sync-over-async from CRM reference validation
acceptanceCriteria: The synchronous SavingChanges override no longer blocks async database work.
The async save path remains unchanged.
A test asserts the synchronous path is rejected or no longer used.

tasks.title: Remove nondeterministic timing and wall-clock dependencies from tests
acceptanceCriteria: No test relies on Task.Delay for synchronization; use deterministic barriers or signals.
Date/time-dependent tests use a controllable TimeProvider with fixed values.
No wall-clock elapsed-time assertions remain in functional tests.
Affected tests pass repeatedly.

tasks.title: Fix Docker test gating and use the production authorization revalidator in web tests
acceptanceCriteria: Docker gating semantics are centralized and explicit: true/1 requires Docker, false/0 skips, unset auto-detects.
The main web integration factory uses the production WebAuthorizationRevalidator.
Claim-only compatibility tests explicitly assert the intended rejection or behavior.
A test proves claim-only principals are rejected in production mode.

tasks.title: Update non-ADR documentation to match the implemented code
acceptanceCriteria: Foundation, module catalog, Identity README, CRM/Sales/Inventory module docs and .opencode context reflect implemented layers and host composition.
CRM and Sales docs no longer claim Infrastructure, API or UI are out of scope.
Inventory docs state Domain plus Application only and that the host does not compose it.
README stack matches actual packages and assets; remove MudBlazor, Tailwind and Docker claims unless they are added.
No file under docs/decisions is modified by this task.

tasks.title: Harden architecture tests for all modules and layers
acceptanceCriteria: Architecture tests discover modules from the solution or project references instead of a hardcoded list.
Missing expected layers fail unless explicitly allowlisted, with Inventory as the only documented exception.
Endpoints cannot reference own Infrastructure, EF Core or BSX.Web; Application cannot reference ASP.NET Core or BSX.Web; Infrastructure cannot reference Endpoints or BSX.Web.
Module classes are subject to sealing and naming rules.
Every IRequest has a permission attribute except an explicit allowlist.
An architecture test rejects literal permission codes.

tasks.title: Standardize created-resource HTTP responses
acceptanceCriteria: All create operations return 201 with a usable Location or consistently use the documented alternative.
Identity created responses do not emit an empty Location.
Subresource creates in CRM use the same policy as top-level creates.
Endpoint tests cover status and Location for each module.

tasks.title: Add session and refresh-token retention cleanup
acceptanceCriteria: Expired and revoked sessions and consumed or expired refresh tokens are purged after a configurable retention period.
Cleanup is idempotent and logged.
Tests cover retention boundaries and repeated execution.

tasks.title: Map known unique-constraint violations to 409 conflicts
acceptanceCriteria: Concurrent duplicate customer, organization, lead, opportunity, user and role inserts return 409 with the platform conflict contract.
Mapping is consistent across Identity, CRM and Sales.
Integration tests force each known unique constraint at the HTTP layer.

tasks.title: Add missing Identity validators and fix invalid-session error semantics
acceptanceCriteria: DiscoverTenantOptionsCommand has a validator equivalent to LoginCommand.
Every public Identity request record has a validator or an explicitly documented exception.
RevokeSession with an empty id returns an invalid-session-id error, not invalid credentials.
Tests cover the new validation and error code.

tasks.title: Use a shared safe return-URL helper in login UI and endpoint
acceptanceCriteria: Login.razor and WebAuthEndpoints use one SafeReturnUrl implementation.
Backslash, scheme-relative and absolute external URLs are rejected consistently.
Tests cover the bypass cases.

tasks.title: Implement the IModule composition contract
acceptanceCriteria: An IModule contract exists with RegisterServices and MapEndpoints.
Each composed module exposes exactly one IModule implementation.
BSX.Web composes modules through IModule and does not reference module Application, Infrastructure or Endpoints projects directly.
A composition test discovers modules only through IModule.

tasks.title: Create Identity.Contracts and move the permission catalog
acceptanceCriteria: BSX.Modules.Identity.Contracts exists and contains permission codes, catalog and cross-module contract types.
IdentityPermissionCodes moves out of Application.
Web and tests reference Identity.Contracts instead of Identity.Application implementation types.
An architecture test requires Contracts for every completed module except the explicitly incomplete Inventory.

tasks.title: Move IIntegrationEvent to BSX.Contracts and add a real integration event
acceptanceCriteria: IIntegrationEvent and its base types live in BSX.Contracts.
Module Contracts can implement integration events without referencing BuildingBlocks.
At least one real integration event is produced and consumed through the outbox.
Architecture tests confirm the dependency direction.

tasks.title: Remove Endpoints-to-Infrastructure project dependencies
acceptanceCriteria: CRM, Identity and Sales Endpoints projects no longer reference their own Infrastructure projects.
Health checks, migration helpers and infrastructure exception filters move to Infrastructure or a composition project.
Endpoint filters depend only on Application or Contracts types.
Architecture tests forbid Endpoints-to-own-Infrastructure and Endpoints-to-EF-Core dependencies.

tasks.title: Complete or explicitly quarantine the Inventory module
acceptanceCriteria: Inventory is either completed with Contracts, Infrastructure, Endpoints, migrations, host registration and UI navigation, or formally removed from the shipping solution.
If kept dormant, its permission catalog is not presented as active and the documentation says so.
Composition tests cover whichever decision is made.

tasks.title: Resolve service-account, API-key and MFA dead surfaces
acceptanceCriteria: Service accounts, API keys and MFA/passkey capabilities are either exposed end-to-end or removed from code, permissions and schema.
No permission is published for a capability that cannot be executed.
The decision is recorded in an ADR if the feature is deferred or removed.

tasks.title: Remove or feature-gate the outbox and event bus until a real consumer exists
acceptanceCriteria: The platform either implements real domain-event consumers and integration producers or removes/feature-gates the outbox, recovery service, IEventBus and integration tables.
No command pays outbox persistence cost without a consumer.
The decision and its operational consequences are documented.

tasks.title: Add CI quality gates for format, coverage, vulnerabilities and migration drift
acceptanceCriteria: CI runs dotnet format --verify-no-changes.
CI enforces a coverage threshold and publishes a coverage report.
CI runs dotnet list package --vulnerable --include-transitive and fails on vulnerabilities.
CI runs dotnet ef migrations has-pending-model-changes for each module with Infrastructure.
CI uses caching, concurrency cancellation and job timeouts.

tasks.title: Consolidate duplicated test infrastructure into a shared test kit
acceptanceCriteria: A shared test-support project contains common fakes, time providers, event dispatchers, Docker gating, test data builders and Web host helpers.
Module-specific test projects reuse the shared kit and keep only module-specific data.
Existing divergent fakes are unified or explicitly documented.

tasks.title: Fix role soft-delete unique index and deletion audit fields
acceptanceCriteria: Role unique indexes are filtered so a soft-deleted role name can be reused.
Role deletion records DeletedOnUtc and DeletedBy consistently with CRM and Sales.
A migration and regression test are added.
The change is reviewed before deployment.

tasks.title: Bind and validate RateLimitOptions from configuration
acceptanceCriteria: Identity:RateLimiting is bound through IOptions with validation.
Operators can tune login, refresh and password-reset limits without code changes.
Startup fails on invalid limits.
Tests cover binding and validation.

tasks.title: Define the cross-module transaction and unit-of-work strategy
acceptanceCriteria: The platform stops opening transactions on every module for every command.
Cross-module atomicity is either implemented or explicitly replaced with documented compensation/saga semantics.
Commands target a single module unless explicitly designed otherwise.
Tests prove single-module commands do not open unrelated module transactions.

tasks.title: Amend or supersede ADRs that no longer match the implemented architecture
acceptanceCriteria: ADR-011, ADR-015, ADR-016, ADR-009, ADR-012, ADR-010 and ADR-018 are reviewed and either implemented or formally superseded/amended.
Each ADR states its actual implementation status.
Architecture diagrams are updated to separate as-built behavior from planned behavior.
Documentation no longer claims nonexistent JWKS, deny-list, tenant switching, encrypted reset outbox or integration events.

tasks.title: Consolidate the two rate-limiting abstractions
acceptanceCriteria: The platform keeps a single rate-limiting abstraction and store.
Identity-specific limits use the same store or a clearly documented adapter.
The dead BuildingBlocks.RateLimiting surface is removed or wired to real consumers.
HA guidance names the actual distributed abstraction.

tasks.title: Harden deployment security: Data Protection, CSP, proxy trust and reset-token transport
acceptanceCriteria: Data Protection keys are protected at rest or stored in a managed key store.
CSP no longer allows arbitrary WebSocket connections; inline script usage is removed or documented.
Production startup validates reverse-proxy trust or requires explicit disablement.
Password-reset tokens are not carried in URLs that are routinely logged.
Security tests or startup checks cover each control.

tasks.title: Add outbox backlog readiness and enable schema verification in production
acceptanceCriteria: A readiness check reports degraded when outbox backlog or dead-letter count exceeds configured thresholds.
Production configuration enables schema verification for each module.
Health-check tests cover healthy and degraded states.
The health-check documentation matches the implementation.
